description:
**HACK.2027** is the flagship **National-Level 24-Hour Hybrid Hackathon** hosted by **SIMATS Engineering (Saveetha School of Engineering), Chennai**. Designed to bring together 1,000+ student innovators, developers, and problem-solvers from across India, HACK.2027 challenges builders to turn bold ideas into working, real-world prototypes.

Whether you are passionate about software engineering, artificial intelligence, hardware & smart systems, or interdisciplinary engineering, HACK.2027 offers a high-energy environment to collaborate, build under pressure, and showcase your technical creativity in front of industry leaders and academic experts.

### Event Dates & Venue
* **Finale Dates:** February 18–19, 2027 (24-Hour Offline Hackathon)
* **Venue:** SIMATS Engineering (Saveetha School of Engineering), Chennai, Tamil Nadu

### Hackathon Format

* **Round 1: Online Idea & PPT Screening (Late January 2027)**
  Teams register on Devfolio and submit their project proposal / presentation (PPT) outlining the problem statement, proposed architecture, innovation, and feasibility. Submissions are evaluated on originality, technical depth, and real-world impact to shortlist the top **75 teams** nationwide.

* **Round 2: 24-Hour Offline Finale on Campus (February 18–19, 2027)**
  Shortlisted finalist teams travel to the SIMATS Engineering campus in Chennai for an intense, non-stop **24-hour live build**. Teams will prototype from scratch, receive guidance during mentor checkpoints, and pitch their working solutions to an expert jury panel for top honors and prizes.

### Why Participate?
* Compete alongside top student builders from across the country
* Receive hands-on mentorship and feedback from industry practitioners and researchers
* Build a functional prototype in 24 hours and showcase it live to an expert jury
* Win exciting cash prizes, awards, and recognition

sponsors.about:
Adaption is a frontier AI lab founded by Sara Hooker and Sudip Roy (former research and inference leaders at Cohere and Google) on a mission to make AI adaptable, efficient, and customizable. Through tools like AutoScientist and Adaptive Data, Adaption lets builders train their own custom AI models in hours starting from raw datasets or a simple description.

As an AI Partner for HACK.2027, Adaption is supporting our builders with:
• $1,250 in Adaption model-training credits for every participant signing up via the official HACK.2027 referral link
• $1,000 in credits and Builder tier access for each member of the team that makes the best use of Adaption
• Exclusive Adaption swag for the winning team
• A live hands-on online workshop led by an Adaption engineer.
sponsors.name: Adaption

sponsors.about: Tin Computer is an autonomous growth agent that connects to a project's GitHub, analytics and Stripe and ships pull requests to grow it: SEO pages, landing-page fixes, ads and support replies. Every eligible team at HACK.2027 gets $299 in Tin Computer credits, one month of the Growth plan.
